title: Fingering on a note is rejected
description: Which finger plays a note — pedagogy's bread and butter on every instrument, not just fretted ones — has no home on the MNX note. This document writes a left-hand fingering as the flat note-level object it would naturally be (the exact shape _x.mnxLab.fingering drafts: hand + finger) and pins the rejection: the note object refuses unevaluated properties. Deliberately not tab-scoped — piano fingering is the same gap.
